---
title: Utility Package for the Data Analytics Course
---


A collection of helper functions designed to simplify common data analytics
tasks so that students can focus on interpretation rather than implementation.

This utility package was developed specifically for the
[Data Analytics](https://discdown.org/dataanalytics/) course taught
at the [University of Innsbruck](https://uibk.ac.at). It contains a series of
miscellaneous functions, including:

* **[radar](man/polarchart.radar.radar.qmd):** A function for plotting segmented
  radar (star/spider) charts based on pandas DataFrames.
* **[spineplot](man/polarchart.spineplot.spineplot.qmd):** A convenience
  function for drawing two-dimensional spine plots from pandas DataFrames.

# Radar (star/spider) plot example

```{python}
from polarchart import get_demodata, radar

# Loading data set shipped with the package; pandas DataFrame
gsa = get_demodata("gsa")
gsa.head(n = 2)

## Plotting
radar(gsa, scale = True, title = "Demo figure", figsize = (10, 8))
```

# Spine plots

NASA space shuttle o-ring failures

```{python}
from pandas import Series, DataFrame
from polarchart import spineplot

fail = Series([2, 2, 2, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1,
               2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1])
fail = fail.map({1: "no", 2: "yes"})
temperature = [53, 57, 58, 63, 66, 67, 67, 67, 68, 69, 70, 70,
               70, 70, 72, 73, 75, 75, 76, 76, 78, 79, 81]

## Constructing pandas DataFrame
df   = DataFrame({"fail": Series(fail).astype("category"),
                  "temperature": temperature})
df.fail = df.fail.cat.reorder_categories(["yes", "no"])

## Plotting
res = spineplot(df, "temperature", "fail", figsize = (7, 3),
                title = "NASA space shuttle o-ring failures")
```


Student Admissions at UC Berkeley

```{python}
from pandas import Categorical, DataFrame
from numpy import repeat
from polarchart import spineplot
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

UCBA = DataFrame({"Admit":  Categorical(repeat(["Admitted", "Rejected"], [12, 12])),
                  "Gender": Categorical(repeat(["Male", "Female", "Male", "Female"], [6, 6, 6, 6])),
                  "Dept":   Categorical(repeat([["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]], 4, axis = 0).flatten()),
                  "Freq":   [512, 353, 120, 138, 53, 22, 89, 17, 202, 131, 94, 24,
                             313, 207, 205, 279, 138, 351, 19, 8, 391, 244, 299, 317]})

fig, axs = plt.subplots(2, 1, figsize = (6, 8))
spineplot(UCBA, x = "Dept", y = "Gender", ax = axs[0])
spineplot(UCBA, x = "Dept", y = "Gender", values = "Freq", labels = "absolute",
          digits = 1, ax = axs[1], fontcolor = "red")
plt.show()
```
